# msp-podping-service

**Category:** Music publishing  
**Repo:** https://github.com/ChadFarrow/msp-podping-service

## Description
Podping notification service for MSP-2.0 — notifies subscribers when podcast/music feeds update (Podcasting 2.0 Podping protocol).

## PC2.0 Specs Used
- Podping (feed-update notifications)
